heading: Lesson One: Surat al-Fātihah and the short Surahs

paragraphs.text: Surat al-Fātihah and as many of the short Surahs as possible, from Surat az-Zalzalah to Surat an-Nās, are to be learnt, corrected in recitation, memorized, and explained for what is obligatory to be understood.

source.title: IMPORTANT LESSONS FOR THE GENERAL UMMAH
